Hideout command catalog filtered by "proxy"
Usage:
  hideout help <command>       open purpose, effects, safety, and recovery
  hideout help search <word>   search by task or keyword
  hideout help all [query]     browse or filter this catalog
  Compatibility: hideout help --all is the same as hideout help all

Stable
  Get started
    doctor            Check installation, runtime, profile, network, and
                      observation readiness with actionable findings.
  Run safely
    run               Run one command inside the selected Hideout VM boundary
                      and observe that command plus its descendants.
  Configure
    connect           Plan and set a profile's desired direct or proxied
                      connection.
    secret            Set, rotate, inspect, or delete named credentials in the
                      daemon-managed secure store (macOS Keychain on supported
                      Macs).

Advanced
  Configure
    init              Initialize or repair a named profile non-interactively
                      through typed init tasks.
    profile           Manage advanced profile identity, network, filesystem,
                      environment, tool, and command-adapter policy.
  Diagnose and recover
    daemon            Start, inspect, reconcile, or stop the per-user Hideout
                      daemon.
